name: Perplexity Computer
desc: A general-purpose digital worker that delegates tasks to sub-agents.
desc_zh: 通用数字员工，会规划工作并把任务分给跨多个模型的子智能体。
solves: Chat gives answers but stops there; describe an outcome and Computer breaks it into tasks that run for hours without you.
solves_zh: 聊天只给答案就停了；描述想要的结果，Computer 会拆成任务并连跑几小时不用你管。
best_for: You need a competitor matrix built from earnings transcripts and want to close the tab while it works.
best_for_zh: 要根据财报电话会议记录做竞品对比表，还想在它干活时直接关掉标签页时。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — perplexity.ai changelog and blog directories）。 Announced 2026-02-25 for Max subscribers and rolled out to all Pro subscribers on 2026-03-12; Enterprise Max and Computer in Slack came the same week. The blog post carries its date in page metadata (2026-02-25) rather than in the body text, so the date-carrying first-party quote is the 2026-03-12 changelog entry. perplexity.ai returns 403 to curl, so pages were read through the page reader; the changelog entry of 2026-03-12 is the date-carrying evidence. 首次公开日期来源：https://www.perplexity.ai/hub/blog/introducing-perplexity-computer 官网未直接确认（403）。
